errors.user_disabled: This account is disabled. Ask an admin.

setup.title: Create the admin account
setup.hint: The first account manages everything and adds the others. Until it exists, anyone who can open this page has full access.
setup.tokenHint: Printed in the server's console when it started. In Docker, find it with docker logs.

errors.setup_token: This device isn't on the server itself. Enter the setup token from the server's console.
errors.generic: Couldn't create the account. Check the token and try again.

account.title: My account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Your other devices were signed out.
account.noAccounts: Nobody has to sign in right now, so there is no account to manage.

list.title: Users
list.label: Users
list.hint: Each user gets what their role allows. Open a user to give them more or less than their role.
list.noAccounts: Nobody has to sign in right now. Create the first admin to turn on accounts and roles.
list.resetHint: They are signed out everywhere and use the new password next time.
list.deleteBody: The account is removed and can't sign in again. Their past actions stay in the logs.

errors.last_admin: The last enabled admin can't be disabled, demoted or deleted.
errors.email_taken: A user with this email already exists.
errors.own_account: You can't change your own role, rights or state.
errors.escalation: You can't give more than you have yourself.

edit.enabledHint: Switching this off signs them out everywhere.
edit.ownAccount: You can't change your own role or rights. Another user manager can.
edit.adminOnly: This is an admin account. Only admins change it.
edit.rightsHint: Same as role follows the role, also when the role changes later. Pick a step to give this user more or less.
edit.adminRights: Admins have every permission. The only thing to change is whether they edit files on other people's workstations.

roles.title: Roles
roles.label: Roles
roles.hint: A role is a set of permissions. Changes apply to its users right away.
roles.deleteBody: The role is removed. This can't be undone.
roles.deleteInUse_one: 1 user has this role. Give them another role first.
roles.deleteInUse_other: {{count}} users have this role. Give them another role first.
roles.adminFixed: The Admin role has every permission. It can't be changed, disabled or deleted.

fields.name: Name
fields.copyHint: Copies that role's permissions. Change them below.
fields.enabledHint: While off, its users can't sign in and are signed out.

errors.role_in_use: Users still have this role. Give them another role first.
errors.name_taken: A role with this name already exists.
errors.role_builtin: The Admin role can't be changed.

rights.printersHint: Write logs accessory installs. Manage adds and edits printers and accessories.
rights.maintenanceHint: Write logs work done. Manage edits the tasks and types.
rights.filamentHint: Write adds and edits spools. Manage changes many spools at once.
rights.projectsHint: Write adds and edits projects and their files. Manage sets up the project folders.
rights.printsHint: Write logs and edits prints. Manage changes print settings.
rights.costsHint: Write makes quotes and orders. Manage changes rates, currency and order statuses.
rights.catalogHint: Read sees the catalog and the presets. Write deletes and restores presets and sets what workstations send and install. Manage adds and edits brands, models, materials and presets, and their import settings.
rights.editOthersHint: Needs projects write. Off: only their own.
rights.editOtherDevicesHint: Change files in folders shared from someone else's workstation.
rights.syncHint: Only the syncs set to allow it.
rights.reviewHint: Only the imports set to allow it.
rights.integrationsHint: Add, sign in and configure integrations and slicers.
rights.hubHint: Pair and edit workstations and change hub settings.
rights.backupHint: Make, download and delete backups. Only admins restore one.
rights.logsHint: Read the logs and change what is logged.
rights.brandingHint: App name, logo and icon for everyone.
rights.alertsHint: Thresholds and the email and ntfy channels.
rights.usersHint: Add and edit users and roles. Never more than they have themselves.

alerts.title: My alerts
alerts.mineHint: Pick what you get. Same as role follows {{role}}, also when it changes later. Notify also sends it to your email or ntfy below.
alerts.userHint: Same as role follows the role. Notify also sends it to the user's own email or ntfy.
alerts.ownAccount: Your own alerts are on the My account page.
alerts.roleHint: What users of this role get unless they change it themselves. A kind only reaches users who have its permission.

kinds.spool_no_open_date: Spool in use without an open date

delivery.title: My delivery
delivery.hint: Where the alerts you set to Notify are sent. The mail and ntfy servers are set up by an admin.
delivery.emailToHint: Leave empty to use your account email ({{email}}).
delivery.ntfyTopicHint: Letters, numbers, - and _. Leave empty to turn ntfy off.
delivery.tokenSet: A token is stored. Type a new one to replace it.
delivery.testNone: Nothing to test. Turn on email or set a topic, and ask an admin whether the servers are on.
